name: americanoo
description: Run social padel games (Americano, Mexicano and 6 more formats): create the game, enter scores, start rounds and follow the live leaderboard.

interface.shortDescription: Padel Americano: rounds, scores and a live leaderboard
interface.longDescription: Set up a padel Americano, Mexicano or one of 6 other social formats in one message. Americanoo builds fair rotations, gives you a link the whole group can follow on any phone, browser or watch, and shows each round court by court with a live leaderboard. Enter scores and start the next round right from the chat. Free, no ads, no sign-up.
defaultPrompt: Set up a padel Americano for Anna, Mikko, Laura, Jussi, Sara, Pekka, Emma and Olli on 2 courts, 24 points.
Show the leaderboard for game JRSFS2.
